'''December 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 9 December 2000. Joe G. won it. It is known from Chad Samuels's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1536">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-cedar-grove-1292000d1536/ cedar-grove-1292000], DeckTech (Chad "JadesFire" Samuels, 11 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-11-cedar-grove-1292000d1536/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' Joe G.
